test_keep_alive_argument: test pybind11 keep_alive policy on method arguments to verify child lifetime is extended by parent
test_keep_alive_return_value: test pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to verify returned child stays alive with parent
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection of circular references involving ParentGC and keep_alive child objects
test_keep_alive_constructor: test pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructor arguments to verify child is kept alive by parent
test_call_guard: test pybind11 call_guard policy including GIL held and released guarded function calls
